records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Kai,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Granite Ventures* just joined on the team plan!

decisions.rationale: Engaged admin: onboarding call held [calendar:4c4247ab], first project reached day 2, and a positive reply [email:27a17900] with no blockers. But 6 days in with no invites sent and key milestone untouched, only 8 days left, and "still getting used to the layout" suggests slow self-driven progress.

draft.subject: Re: Anything I can help with?
draft.body:
Hi Kai,

Glad to hear things are going well and that the layout is starting to click — totally normal in the first week.

Since you've got your first project going, the natural next step is adding tasks inside it (projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them) and bringing your team in — a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Want me to walk through that with you on a short call this week?

Best,
Chidi
